import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
DB = 'flags.db'
AUDIT_URL = 'https://audit.internal.example.com/api/role-events'

def grant_flag_editor_role(user_id: str, project_key: str) -> str:
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (user_id, project_key, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor')", (user_id, project_key))
        c.commit()
        # Notify the internal audit service about the role change
        payload = json.dumps({'user_id': user_id, 'project_key': project_key, 'role': 'editor'}).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(AUDIT_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
        except Exception:
            pass
    finally:
        c.close()
    return f'{user_id} is now editor on {project_key}'
